name: Portrait Roma
insider_take: A sophisticated sanctuary where Roman elegance meets contemporary luxury in the heart of the Eternal City.
whats_special: Portrait Roma is perched on the legendary Via del Corso, offering unparalleled views of the Spanish Steps and Rome's historic rooftops. This intimate boutique hotel features only 14 suites, each uniquely designed with handcrafted furnishings and marble bathrooms. The rooftop terrace provides breathtaking panoramic views of the city's ancient monuments and terracotta skyline.
pro_tip: Book a suite facing the Spanish Steps for sunrise views, and visit the rooftop terrace at golden hour when the Roman light creates magical shadows across the city's domes and bell towers.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you steps away from luxury shopping on Via Condotti, while the Trevi Fountain and Pantheon are within easy walking distance. The exclusive rooftop restaurant offers refined Italian cuisine with arguably the best dining views in central Rome.
pros: Prime location near Via del Corso and Spanish Steps
Elegant luxury boutique design with sophisticated decor
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Rooftop terrace with panoramic views of Rome
cons: Limited number of rooms due to boutique size
